text:
maria (secops): Heads-up: monitoring flagged a partial TLS chain issue for our smtp-relay service used by alerting/email (smtp-relay.redwood.internal). cert chain returns `unable to get local issuer` from some AZs.
eli (eng-infra): ack, can you paste the check output?
maria (secops): sure — quick openssl run from staging:
```
openssl s_client -connect smtp-relay.redwood.internal:587 -starttls smtp -showcerts
CONNECTED(00000003)
139862... error:14094410:SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:sslv3 alert handshake failure
verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate
---
Certificate chain
 0 s:/CN=smtp-relay.redwood.internal
 1 s:/CN=intermediate-1.redwood-ca
---
```
sam (oncall): is this the same cert we rotated last quarter?
maria (secops): yes but looks like intermediate expired on 2026-09-15 in one region's ACM copy. automated renewal failed for a subset of hosted certs.
eli (eng-infra): on it. I'll check ACM and the loadbalancer chain. tagging @sam to help validate alerting delivery after fix. ETA 35m.
sec-bot: Incident created: SEC-2026-0921. Priority: P2. Runbook: https://confluence.internal/redwood/security/runbooks/smtp-cert-chain.
maria (secops): immediate actions: 1) Confirm which cert ARNs are out-of-date 2) Re-import correct intermediate into ACM 3) Force rotation on the ELB/NLB targets 4) Validate send/receive for PagerDuty/email alerts and CI webhooks.
eli (eng-infra): I found the bad ARN: arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate/abcd-legacy-int. Looks like the automation skipped it due to tag mismatch. Replacing now.
eli (eng-infra): command I used: `aws acm import-certificate --certificate fileb://site.crt --private-key fileb://site.key --certificate-chain fileb://chain.pem --region us-east-1`
maria (secops): after you rotate please rotate SMTP creds cached in alerting workers (short-lived tokens) and restart the alert dispatcher. docs: https://confluence.internal/redwood/ops/alerting#rotate-smtp
sam (oncall): will run functional test after rotation: `curl -v smtp://smtp-relay.redwood.internal:587 --mail-from test@redwood.com --mail-rcpt ops@redwood.com`
eli (eng-infra): rotated intermediate and reattached cert to ALB target group in us-east-1. propagation started.
maria (secops): verify emails coming through?
sam (oncall): test email received in 3m. PagerDuty alarm test also successful. :thumbsup:
sec-bot: SEC-2026-0921 status -> mitigated (cert chain repaired).
maria (secops): follow-ups: - add a check to the certificate-renewer job to validate certificate chain across all regions (not just primary) - fix tagging rule so automation doesn't skip legacy ARNs - rotate any long-lived SMTP tokens by EOD - notify SREs to confirm there are no other intermediates with expiry <30 days.
eli (eng-infra): opened infra task INFRA-4823 to add cross-region chain check, ETA next sprint.
maria (secops): additional security note: our Okta session policy currently allows max session 24h for service accounts. We should reduce interactive session max to 8h and force re-auth for high-priv roles. Requesting identity change with urgency medium.
okta-bot: Okta: change request created CR-2026-79 by maria (secops). Approvers: platform-iam, security-lead.
sam (oncall): action owner for Okta change?
maria (secops): @eli can you coordinate with identity team? If not available, I'll escalate to platform-iam. We want policy enforced by sept 24.
eli (eng-infra): I'll reach out to platform-iam now and include token rotation guidance for service accounts.
maria (secops): thanks. Closing thread summary: cert chain issue discovered -> intermediate expired in subset of ACM copies -> rotated chain and verified alerting. Follow-up: infra automation fix (INFRA-4823), rotate long-lived SMTP tokens, reduce Okta interactive session timeout to 8h for high-priv roles. Please add any missed items.
